definitions.gloss: to master; to acquire; to learn (a skill or knowledge)
definitions.explanation: To gain proficiency in a skill, language, or body of knowledge through study and practice.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{習得|しゅうとく}する。
{外国語|がいこくご}を{習得|しゅうとく}するには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to acquire a foreign language.

examples.japanese: {研修|けんしゅう}を{通|つう}じて{基本的|きほんてき}なスキルを{習得|しゅうとく}した。
examples.english: I acquired basic skills through the training program.

notes: Implies learning through sustained effort and practice, resulting in genuine proficiency. Contrasts with {学|まな}ぶ (to study/learn, more general) and {覚|おぼ}える (to memorize/learn, often for specific facts). Common objects include {言語|げんご} (language), {技術|ぎじゅつ} (technique/skill), {知識|ちしき} (knowledge), and スキル (skill). The related word {取得|しゅとく} focuses on formally obtaining qualifications or certifications.
